schm.f.agg_arg: {f}: one column is expected, for example {f}([Area])
schm.f.agg_here: {f}: a group function cannot be used here
schm.f.unit_root: square root of a value in {a}: the units cannot be halved
schm.f.unit_unknown: the result has no schedule unit ({a})
schm.f.round_digits: the number of decimals in round must be a whole number
schm.f.condition: the condition of if must be a number or a comparison
cmd.mgr.schedules.desc: Opens project schedules: several categories in one table, formula columns, cell edits as a draft, XLSX export and import.
schm.ui.title: Project schedules
schm.ui.none_hint: Press New to define a schedule over one or more categories.
schm.ui.name: Name
schm.ui.columns_hint: Column keys separated by semicolons; a formula is Name = expression, for example Area = len * h. Functions: round, min, max, abs, sqrt, if, sum, avg, count, total.
schm.ui.no_rows: No rows in the chosen categories
schm.ui.edit_cell: Edit cell of the selected row
schm.ui.draft_empty: Nothing staged. Pick a row, choose a column and type a value.
schm.ui.applied: Applied {n} cells as one undo step
schm.ui.imported: Book read: {n} changed cells staged as a draft
schm.ui.filters_hint: Column: filter, separated by semicolons, for example h: >2500; cat: Doors. Filters use the syntax of the schedule filter row.
schm.not_editable: computed or absent in this category, not editable
schm.gone: the element or column no longer exists
schm.filter_after_agg: A filter on a computed column hides rows after group functions are summed; they still count those rows.
schm.dup_header: Two columns share the header "{h}"; an XLSX import cannot tell them apart and skips both.
schm.ambiguous_header: Book header "{h}" is used by several columns: not read
